description_en: Subscribes to a conversation message stream
name: StreamChatMessage

parameters.help_en: The ID of the effective tenant
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The assistant message ID returned by sendAsyncChatMessage. A 404 error is returned if the message does not belong to the current tenant
parameters.help_zh: 助手消息ID，由sendAsyncChatMessage返回；不属于当前租户时返回404
parameters.name: message_id

parameters.help_en: The last received SSE event ID, used for resuming delivery after a disconnection. If not specified, the full stream is replayed from the beginning
parameters.help_zh: 上次接收到的 SSE event id，用于断线续推；不传则从头全量回放
parameters.name: last_event_id
